displayName: DSCP-T7 ECO multi-domain adapter and tests
priorAbsorption: DSCP-T7 adds a deterministic local ECO-to-DSCP adapter and focused tests. No live ECO retrieval, provider call, corpus ingestion, T12 authorization, public-sync, or production/public readiness is claimed.

findings.summary: Reviewer used a widened rootDir TypeScript command because ECO rootDir is package-local while T7 intentionally imports sibling CPF types.
findings.nextAction: Future cross-extension work orders should record the package-specific TypeScript command before dispatch.

nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan only when DSCP ECO adapter behavior changes or future ECO retrieval runtime integration is authorized.
